description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a visitor, I want visible and machine-discoverable feed links, so that I can subscribe using a browser or reader.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Discover feed links without exposing private material
  Scenario: Discover subscriptions
    Given a public publication page and section page
    When I inspect the page or use a feed-aware reader
    Then I can find clearly labeled RSS and Atom links for the relevant scope
    And machine-readable alternate links identify their formats
    And feed responses use the correct format and content type
  Scenario: Enforce published-only exposure
    Given draft articles, private research, editorial notes and private assets exist
    When I fetch a feed anonymously
    Then none of those private values or draft asset URLs are included
    And a draft-only article cannot be retrieved by guessing a feed URL
```
